name: Portugal: check of forms and supplied documents

common.check: Trial title and EU trial number (if assigned) match the protocol and CTIS.
Every field the assistant answers is answered; fields that belong to the site, investigator, insurer or another party are left empty, not invented.
Language is Portuguese or English; signed and dated where the Portugal checklist requires it (M1, M2, N1 site declaration, service authorisation, O1), unsigned otherwise unless CEIC asks.
CTIS title follows the naming guide and requirements.json.
Site names, investigators, team functions and participant estimates consistent across CTIS, CV, site declaration and financial documents.

PT-K1.check: Uses the current EudraLex recruitment and informed-consent procedure template.

Explains who identifies potential participants, who makes the first contact, whether medical records are reviewed before contact, what pre-screening data are collected and how undue influence is avoided.

The yes/no answers for incapacitated adults, minors, impartial witness and emergency match the project's populations and study facts; each 'yes' section is completed with the Portuguese rules (national_fields), each 'no' section gives the not-applicable answer.
Minors section: Law No 9/2026 assent at 16 and 17 and for capable children under 16, written assent at 16, own consent at 18, representative authority verified, no universal two-parent rule.
Incapacitated adults section: representative definition and verification, no prior consent or refusal before incapacity, adapted information, objection respected, re-consent on regained capacity.
Emergency section: every condition of Law No 9/2026 Article 8(3) and Article 35 CTR, who confirms them, what is recorded, timing and who conducts subsequent consent.
Witness section: trigger limited to inability to write; impartiality and selection; interpreter role separate.
Recruitment routes and first act of recruitment match the recruitment material (K2) and the protocol.

PT-M1.check: One current CV per principal investigator at each Portuguese site, on the EudraLex template or equivalent.
Shows relevant education, clinical-trial experience and ability to conduct the protocol; GCP information present or a separate GCP certificate planned (PT-M-GCP).
Signed and dated by the investigator before submission.
Only trial fields were prepared by the assistant; personal details come from the investigator.
Site name and investigator identity match CTIS, the site declaration and the financial documents.

PT-M2-DOI.check: One declaration per principal investigator and site, on the EudraLex template.
Signed and dated by the investigator before submission.
Only trial title and EU trial number were prepared by the assistant.

PT-M-GCP.check: A GCP certificate is present when the CV does not sufficiently document GCP competence or the Portuguese checklist requests it.
Certificate names the investigator and is current for the role.

PT-N1.check: One declaration per Portuguese site on the EudraLex form, with the national site detail: infrastructure, equipment, human resources, expected recruitment and ability to perform this protocol.
Pharmaceutical services and the IMP circuit (receipt, storage, preparation, dispensing, return, destruction) are covered or referenced to PT-N-PHARMACY.
Any external facility is identified with the reason it is needed.
Site name, principal investigator and planned participant number match CTIS, the CV and the financial documents; site fields were left for the site, not invented.
Signed and dated at submission by the correct signatory (CEIC checklist: Director of Service).

PT-N-SERVICE.check: Authorisation to conduct the trial in the service and for the composition of the research team is present for each site.
Authored, signed and dated by the Director of Service.
Team composition and functions match N1 and the financial arrangements (P2).

PT-N-PHARMACY.check: Declaration from the pharmaceutical services present for each site.
IMP circuit describes control of receipt, storage, preparation, dispensing, return and destruction, consistent with the protocol and pharmacy manual.

PT-N-COORDINATOR.check: Employment, authority, confidentiality and institutional-agreement evidence for the external study coordinator, as requested in the CEIC checklist.

PT-N-EXTERNAL.check: External facility identified, need explained and described in the site declaration.
Insurance cover extended to the facility (O1).

PT-O1.check: Certificate identifies the trial, insurer, insured party, policy number, type of insurance, coverage and validity.
Dated and signed by the insurer and valid at submission.
Cover valid during the trial and for 12 months after the last participant completes the study in Portugal (or any longer period set by CEIC).
Covers every Portuguese site and applicable external facility.
Insurance wording in the PIS and ICF matches the certificate.

PT-O2.check: Low-intervention trial with evidence that existing civil-liability insurance covers the statutory damage; CEIC acceptance obtained or requested.

PT-P2.check: One financial-arrangements document per site: final contract, agreed contract model or a document with the mandatory minimum information (CEIC guidance, 24 August 2022).
A definitive contract identifies sponsor, site, principal investigator and any other party and is signed by all parties before it takes effect.
Remuneration and functions of the research team consistent with the site declaration; site costs, investigator payments, participant expenses or compensation and external providers addressed.
Free supply of IMP, auxiliary medicines, administration devices and protocol-only consultations or tests, and the post-trial continuation pathway, consistent with the participant information.

PT-P1.check: Amounts, calculation, payment schedule and conditions described.
No completion bonus or payment structure that could pressure a participant to remain; prorating after withdrawal stated.
Amounts and conditions identical in P1, P2 and every participant document.

PT-Q-FEE.check: No unsupported payment document uploaded; the CTIS contact who receives the electronic fee links is correct.
Fee paid or exemption processed through the electronic process after submission, following current CEIC and INFARMED instructions.

PT-R1.check: GDPR-compliance statement submitted in the CTIS Form section and covering the Portuguese trial activities; no Part II duplicate unless decided (DECISIONS.md D2).
Portuguese-law sentence (Law No 58/2019) present if chosen, and consistent with the participant privacy wording.
Sponsor name, role and date fields completed from the sources, not invented.

PT-S1.check: Current EudraLex biological-samples template used; new and archive sample sections match the protocol and sample plan; at least one is completed.
Collection, purpose, storage location, coding or anonymisation, duration, recipients and optional future use match the participant documents and R1.
Section 5 contains the Portugal-specific information (Law No 12/2005, Decree-Law No 131/2014, Law No 58/2019 Article 31) rather than a generic statement.
Future use answered consistently with the separate future-use document or section.
Biobank or collection transfers: consented purpose and approval of the responsible ethics committees addressed.
